reviews.decision_reason: demand_selection preserves all supplied demand rows, including the explicit fallback records, and constructs the selected needs without adding unrelated or generic keyword-only candidates. The supplied input/output show all eight corpus records retained for downstream use.

evidence_normalization retains only the allowed record identifiers, normalizes the required evidence fields, and applies the bounded eight-row window. The assigned output still contains the same eight demand records with no missing or contradictory evidence introduced by this boundary.

provenance_assembly deterministically ranks normalized records by demand_score descending with record_id as the tie breaker, producing evidence source ranks that support the downstream unsupported-priority recommendation for n06-r01. The two controller-recorded handoffs have matching producer and consumer hashes, so the handoff behavior is preserved.
